title: Continuous learning governance
summary: Turn verified outcomes into candidate lessons and skills through evidence, validation and authorized promotion, with project isolation, monitoring and rollback.

provenance.notes: ECC promotes instincts by frequency and confidence. Here frequency never promotes: only verified outcomes feed candidates and only a signed authorization activates one.

outputs.name: candidates
outputs.description: Candidate lessons with evidence references and confidence.

outputs.name: health
outputs.description: Per-skill acceptance trend with unmeasured skills distinguished from healthy ones.

workflow.step: Collect observations only from outcomes with runtime verification and an independent acceptance; ignore worker prose and unverified claims.
Scope each candidate to its project; cross-project promotion needs independent supporting evidence from each project.
workflow.check: No lesson crosses a project boundary on one observation.

workflow.step: Deduplicate by content digest and score confidence from verified outcomes, not from how often something was said.
workflow.check: Repetition alone does not raise confidence.

workflow.step: Promote only through an authorized, signed, single-use grant bound to the exact digest and project.
workflow.check: A model cannot promote its own lesson.

workflow.step: Monitor outcomes per skill version; report unmeasured separately from healthy, flag decline, and revoke or roll back on authorization.
workflow.check: A revoked skill is absent from new task snapshots.

constraints: Never let worker output promote itself into trusted policy.
A candidate is inactive instructional text until promoted.
Keep an audit trail that the actor described cannot rewrite.

examples.title: Popular but wrong
examples.situation: A pattern appears in many worker summaries but fails review.
examples.guidance: Its observation count is high and its verified-acceptance count is zero, so it never becomes a candidate.

verification: Candidates link to verified evidence and a project.
Promotion and revocation appear in the audit history with an authenticated principal.

task.text: Review how a lesson is promoted and whether a revoke or rollback is possible for a candidate skill.
Evaluate skill health and decline for the learning instinct.
